name: @diaryx/leaf
description: Framework-agnostic rich-text editor for the web: a proportional WYSIWYG surface over leaf-core's caret model, compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/leaf-wasm --profile wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/leaf-web/pkg && wasm-pack build ../../crates/leaf-math-wasm --profile wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/leaf-web/pkg-math
scripts.build:wasm:dev: wasm-pack build ../../crates/leaf-wasm --dev --target web --out-dir ../../packages/leaf-web/pkg && wasm-pack build ../../crates/leaf-math-wasm --dev --target web --out-dir ../../packages/leaf-web/pkg-math
scripts.prepack: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');for(const d of ['pkg','pkg-math']){const w=require('./'+d+'/package.json');if(w.version!==p.version)throw new Error(d+'/ is '+w.name+' '+w.version+', not '+p.version+' - run npm run build:wasm')}" && rm -f pkg/.gitignore pkg-math/.gitignore
